description: The inventory covers signs on roads DC1, DC3 and DC29. A main sheet describes location, installation, sign specifications and inspection results, including retroreflection compliance and physical condition. Ten summary sheets provide counts, average ages and signs that fail specified requirements. This source-defined asset and condition information supports representation and assessment of road infrastructure. The metadata do not state the inspection dates, complete sign count or the detailed technical thresholds. Access is restricted, with no visible file descriptors. Compliance labels remain source reports and were not independently checked against standards or actual sign measurements. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
